artifacts.summary: Re-derives the 6-deliverable dispatch against live state: deliverables 1 (batch-of-one deferral) and 6 (owed-sweep discharge) are already fully implemented by tasks 610/650; deliverable 5's declaration surface (verification_scope.closing_gate) is already reserved by name in repo-level-declarations.md; deliverables 2 (plan-format.md vocabulary), 3 (non-orchestrated path, found largely vacuous), and 4 (red-close task-status binding, the one genuinely open design question) are resolved with explicit decisions and rejected alternatives recorded.

memory_candidates.content: Task 610 (full_gate_verification_ceiling_and_stall, COMPLETED) already removed orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh's `.task_numbers | length > 1` gate on --batch-gate-deferral and shipped the batch-gate-pending marker + verify-deploy.sh/run-all.sh entry guards that make unconditional deferral safe. context/contracts/batch-gate-stage.md already documents this as current ('Single-task invariance... superseded a task-count-gated predecessor'). A dispatch description's 'WHAT THE DESIGN DOES TODAY' framing can go stale between authoring and execution when a sequenced prerequisite task lands in between -- always re-derive against live state before trusting it.

context/standards/repo-level-declarations.md's verification_scope object on .claude-extensions.json already reserves two field names, project_gates and closing_gate, explicitly for two named future records (batch_gate_deferral_narrowing_for_project_sources and orchestration_close_owns_full_battery respectively) -- verification-scope-lib.sh does not yet read or validate either. This is the established pattern for adding a new declaration concern to this repo: reuse the one hand-authored sibling-key surface via a reserved field name, never add a second competing top-level key.

No skill or command other than skill-orchestrate dispatches any implementation agent in this repository (confirmed by grep across every skills/*/SKILL.md and commands/*.md for general-implementation-agent, email-implementation-agent, lean-implementation-agent, nix-implementation-agent, neovim-implementation-agent -- zero hits outside skill-orchestrate). A design question premised on 'a task implemented outside /orchestrate' should be checked against this before building a fallback mechanism for a path that may not exist live.
